page.notes: Marginal notes in the right margin, placed beside the lines where they stand: "Varro lib. 1. de vita pop. Rom." (beside "populus"), "Macrob. lib. 1. Saturnal. c. 13." (beside "impetranda"), "Ouid. 2. & 4. Fast." (beside "piaculis"). The note text in the margin is small and partly faint; the book numbers in the notes (1, 13, 2, 4) are doubtful. The final word of the page, "ve-", is cut off at the line end, and the bottom mark is only a faint signature, so the signature "c" is doubtful. The "Virgo" and "Maria" words and the "Februa"/"februare" words are set in italic. The margin notes are not in the text; they are shown here as notes only and are not transcribed into the main text.
